items.title: Cricket legends urge Pakistan to provide 'proper medical care' for Imran Khan
items.standfirst: Former cricket captains - including Sir Alastair Cook and Mike Atherton - have urged Pakistan to ensure jailed former prime minister Imran Khan receives "humane treatment and proper medical care".
items.content: Former cricket captains - including Sir Alastair Cook and Mike Atherton - have urged Pakistan to ensure jailed former prime minister Imran Khan receives "humane treatment and proper medical care".

items.title: Ex-cricket captains urge 'proper medical care' for Imran Khan
items.standfirst: The former skippers say it is "basic decency" for Pakistan to comply with a court-ordered medical assessment.
items.content: The former skippers say it is "basic decency" for Pakistan to comply with a court-ordered medical assessment.
